visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts in a brightly lit indoor restaurant. A young woman with long dark hair and bangs, wearing a grey ribbed button-up shirt, sits at a wooden table. Two large pizzas are in front of her; one has olives and cheese, the other has ham and mushrooms. She looks at the food with a neutral but pleasant expression. A bottle of chili oil and two glasses of dark soda are also visible on the table. (2) The scene transitions to the young woman eating the pizza. She uses a knife and fork to cut a slice of the ham and mushroom pizza, lifting it to her mouth. The background shows a white wall and a red cushioned booth. Her micro-actions include smiling at the camera while holding the slice. The lighting is warm and even throughout the indoor space. (3) Moving outdoors to a cloudy day in Paris, the woman is seen wearing a beige trench coat over a white top and blue denim jeans. She stands in a paved public square with the Luxor Obelisk visible in the background. Her posture is relaxed, and she carries a large white tote bag on her shoulder. The sky is overcast with grey and white clouds, providing flat, natural lighting. (4) At a famous monument, the young woman is joined by an older woman. They both smile and laugh while posing for a selfie in front of the Arc de Triomphe. The camera moves in a handheld, slightly shaky manner as they turn around to capture the monument. The street is busy with cars and tourists in the background. (5) A quick cut shows a retail storefront with a creative display of white, stylized mannequins positioned on vertical and horizontal metal bars in various athletic poses. The lighting is artificial and bright inside the window. The woman walks past a revolving glass door as she enters or leaves a building, her expression cheerful. (6) The final shots focus on food close-ups. A piece of yellow asparagus is held with dark chopsticks over a white plate covered in a light brown sauce. The woman is shown eating a piece of food with a satisfied expression. The camera uses a close-up shot size to emphasize the texture and color of the food.
